name: HEC Indigenous PhD Fellowships for Pakistani Nationals
amount: PKR 100,000/month + Full Tuition Fee Waiver
eligibility: Pakistani/AJK nationals with minimum 16 years of education (BS/MS) and minimum 3.0 CGPA. Age under 35 years.

name: Fulbright Pakistan Student Program (Master's & PhD)
amount: Full Tuition, Airfare, Living Stipend & Health Insurance (~$60,000/yr)
eligibility: Pakistani citizens with 16 years of education for Master's or 18 years for PhD. GRE required.

name: Chevening UK Government Scholarships
amount: Full University Tuition, Monthly Allowance, Travel Grants
eligibility: Undergraduate degree with at least 2 years of professional work experience and demonstrated leadership potential.

name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) Master's Scholarships
amount: 100% Tuition Fees + Monthly Living Allowance
eligibility: Domicile of Punjab, secured admission in partner universities, monthly family income <= PKR 60,000.

name: Commonwealth Master's & PhD Scholarships
amount: Full Tuition, Return Flights, Monthly Stipend (£1,347 - £1,652)
eligibility: Citizen of eligible Commonwealth country, minimum upper second class (2:1) undergraduate honors.

name: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS) Germany
amount: €934/month + Travel Subsidy + Health Insurance
eligibility: Bachelor degree, minimum 2 years relevant work experience, English or German proficiency.

name: Turkiye Burslari Full Postgraduate Scholarships
amount: University Placement, Tuition Waiver, Free Accommodation, Monthly Stipend
eligibility: Non-Turkish citizens, minimum 75% academic GPA for Master's/PhD, age under 30 for Master's.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees (EMJM)
amount: Full Tuition, €1,400/month Living Allowance, Travel Contribution
eligibility: Bachelor's degree or in final year of undergraduate studies. Open to students globally.

name: Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarship Project Phase III
amount: 100% Tuition Fee + PKR 4,000 Monthly Living Stipend
eligibility: Newly admitted undergraduate students in designated public universities with verified household need.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum Hungarian State Scholarship
amount: Tuition Exemption, HUF 43,700/month Stipend, Dormitory Accommodation
eligibility: Nomination through HEC Pakistan portal. Minimum 12-16 years education depending on level.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships for Pakistan
amount: Full Tuition, Return Airfare, Establishment Allowance, Fortnightly Contribution
eligibility: Pakistani citizen with minimum 16 years education and relevant leadership focus.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) Bilateral Program
amount: Full Tuition Waiver, On-campus Housing, Comprehensive Medical, Monthly Allowance
eligibility: Pakistani citizen, non-Chinese nationality, nominated via HEC online application.

name: Rhodes Scholarships at Oxford University
amount: All Oxford University fees, Annual Living Stipend (£19,092), Airfare
eligibility: Completed undergraduate degree with First Class honors, age 18-24, demonstrated high leadership.

name: Ignite National Technology Fund - SEED Startup Grant
amount: Up to PKR 5,000,000 (Equity-Free Non-Dilutive Grant)
eligibility: Pakistani student founders and startups with working MVP or breakthrough prototype in 4IR technologies.

name: Karandaaz Innovation Challenge Fund (ICF Round 10)
amount: Up to PKR 15,000,000 in Matching Grants
eligibility: Tech-enabled solutions driving digital financial inclusion for MSMEs and unbanked populations.

name: National Incubation Center (NIC) Cohort Seed Stipend
amount: PKR 1,500,000 Seed Grant + Free Office Space & Cloud Credits
eligibility: Student founders or early-stage startups across Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Quetta, Hyderabad.

name: PSEB IT Startup Export Acceleration Grant
amount: Up to PKR 3,000,000 Non-repayable grant
eligibility: Registered IT startups with demonstrable software solutions aimed at international export markets.

name: HEC Technology Development Fund (TDF)
amount: Up to PKR 14,000,000 Project Grant
eligibility: University students/faculty collaborating with industrial partner to convert academic IP into marketable product.

name: PlanX Tech Catalyst Accelerate Grant
amount: PKR 2,500,000 + Venture Network Access
eligibility: Tech startups founded by recent graduates with initial customer traction seeking scaling support.

name: P@SHA Tech Innovation & Social Impact Fund
amount: PKR 2,000,000 Equity-free
eligibility: Student founders creating open-source civic tech, assistive tech, or climate adaptation software.

name: Google for Startups Cloud & AI Catalyst Fund
amount: Up to $100,000 in Google Cloud & Gemini AI Credits + Mentorship
eligibility: Early-stage AI-first startups building with LLMs or cloud infrastructure, founded within last 3 years.

name: Y Combinator Startup School Grants
amount: $10,000 Equity-Free Grant + Global Community Access
eligibility: Active participants in YC Startup School track with validated user interviews and functioning MVP.

name: MIT Solve Global Challenges Innovation Grant
amount: $10,000 to $50,000 in Direct Pilot Grants
eligibility: Open to innovators globally addressing climate adaptation, financial health, or educational equity.

name: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Grand Challenges Explorations
amount: $100,000 Initial Phase I Grant
eligibility: Student researchers and tech teams with unconventional, radical ideas to solve global health inequities.

name: GIKI Technology Incubation Center Seed Catalyst
amount: PKR 1,000,000 Prototype Development Fund
eligibility: Undergraduate engineering and computing students developing patentable hardware or embedded software.

eligibility: Pakistani youth-led organizations or startups targeting water management, clean energy, or digital literacy.
